source_audits.native_and_regression: All 3584 tracked source hashes match 4328701bc, with no extra .rs/.py/.toml sources. Eight parameter-history files generated by this run under crates/casa-ms/.casa-rs were removed. Dedicated debug and release-validation targets.
source_audits.oracle_tools: All 106 tracked tool/input files match d7d5aa380.
source_audits.matched_control: All 3584 source hashes match 178233184. git diff 4328701bc..178233184 changes only baseline.rs, direction.rs and write/geometry.rs, restoring the pre-fix calculations. Separate source and build target; refreshed all source mtimes after cloning caches.
source_audits.pre_time_fix_regression: All 3582 tracked files matched e33e9bd70 before the first full types/MS/simulation run; no extra code files. Its source and native Rust calculation are retained exactly.

upstream_read.focus: Baseline inverse annual aberration uses STANDARD(TDB) and applies the final Newton correction before checking convergence; MEpoch(Quantity(TIME,"s"),UT1) multiplies by the precomputed seconds-to-days conversion factor.

baseline.failed_comparator_reporting: A failed legacy comparator stops on the first failing row. These full-column probes supply actual global maxima, not the failed comparator largest field.

independent_rotation_fixture.input: Three TDB epochs and two J2000 phase centres; matrix quotient of CASA MCBaseline APP->JNAT and JTRUE->J2000 isolates inverse annual aberration without IERS data. Raw matrices retained.

commands.full_regression: RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 cargo test -p casa-types -p casa-ms -p casa-simulation
commands.integrated_regression: cargo clippy -p casa-types -p casa-simulation --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test -p casa-types annual_aberration_matches_casa_baseline_rotations -- --nocapture; RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 cargo test -p casa-simulation
commands.long_arrays: CASAPY tools/simulation/simobserve_parity.py --out OUT --casars-bin TARGET/release-validation/release/simobserve --casatestdata PUBLIC_LOCAL_COPY --only uvw_long_vla_2017 uvw_long_vla_2025 uvw_long_alma_2017
commands.compact_replay: CASAPY tools/simulation/simobserve_parity.py --out OUT --casars-bin TARGET/release-validation/release/simobserve --casatestdata PUBLIC_LOCAL_COPY --uvw-tolerance-m 1e-6 --only model_direction model_cell model_direction_cell components_cube frame_topo coarse_cell schedule_hour_number schedule_hour_quantity schedule_refdate_modern schedule_square frame_lsrd frame_geo frame_galacto frame_lgroup frame_cmb pointing_file_multiple pointing_explicit_spacing
commands.strict_recomparison: Using d7d5aa380 compare_case over the three retained final native/CASA outputs with caller uvw_tolerance_m=1e-3. Each case independently caps UVW at 1e-6 absolutely and requires exact finite stored TIME; the ordinary full MS comparator still also runs.

validation.full_regression_ignored: Four optional plot/large-disk diagnostics and five parent-executed counting/holding/PSF helpers.
validation.integrated_scope: One independent rotation unit plus all 301 simulation tests, including actual Metal backend comparisons, worker laws, the complete session-memory suite and existing-MS patch laws. Two ignored entries are parent-executed counting/PSF helpers. Unchanged types/MS evidence is retained at e33e9bd70.
validation.strict_clippy: Passed all targets of casa-types and casa-simulation on integrated native source.
validation.format_architecture_docs: Passed on d7d5aa380 before receipt/docs additions.
validation.interop: CASA C++ reads all 19 successful native MeasurementSets and image products in the full paired comparator. The optional pkg-config casacore feature gate was not run: casacore development package is absent on the host.

review.kind: One fresh-context Astra xhigh local review required for shared calculation machinery

findings.finding: Strict cases inherited a relative TIME tolerance, allowing unequal stored TIME.
findings.resolution: Exact finite stored TIME is required independently; one-ULP regression fails before and passes after.

findings.finding: Legacy comparator adds a relative UVW allowance above the advertised absolute cap.
findings.resolution: Full-column absolute-only UVW bound at min(caller, case cap), with rejection immediately above the cap and at 30 km even with a looser caller. Stricter callers, non-finite geometry and missing MSs also fail closed.

review.demonstration: Three new regressions failed before the fixes; a fourth missing-MS regression also failed before its fix. All 14 tool tests now pass locally and under CASA Python; all three real saved outputs pass the strengthened full comparisons.

decisions: Reuse the already implemented, cached casacore STANDARD velocity for phase-centre and baseline conversion; do not add another ephemeris implementation or dependency.
Match C++ Newton termination and its Quantity seconds-to-days scale through the existing MEpoch constructor.
Enforce the unchanged 1 micrometre goal absolutely for the three new cases at exactly equal TIME. Preserve historical comparator allowances for older scenarios.
Measure native task defaults (balanced workers, auto backend). RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 does not force simulator worker count; no W1 claim is made for these task timings.
limits: Scoped proof for the named arrays, dates and model/scheduling/frame cases; other simulator modes and the full issue remain open.
Performance covers these short three-integration workloads only; no whole-program speedup claim.
Plotting remains paused under owner sequencing. No plotting implementation is added.

performance.simulation_execution_controls: Unmodified task defaults: balanced workers and auto backend; RAYON_NUM_THREADS does not force simulator worker count.
